name: Employee of the month
description: Celebrate a colleague: a big circular photo in a gold ring, their name and role, a quote in their own words, a fun fact and a badge for the month.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best.

params.name: photo
params.label: Photo
params.help: A head-and-shoulders photo, cropped to fit the frame. Square photos work best.

params.name: show_photo
params.label: Show the photo
params.help: Off shows a circle with the initials below instead, for anyone who would rather not have a photo up.

params.name: initials
params.label: Initials
params.help: Shown in the circle when the photo is off. One or two letters.

params.name: eyebrow
params.label: Small heading
params.help: Above the name. Capitals read best.

params.name: name
params.label: Name
params.help: One line, up to 26 characters. Type it in normal mixed case; ALL CAPS is wider and may not fit.

params.name: role
params.label: Role
params.help: Job title, team, class or site. Longer roles wrap onto a second line.

params.name: show_quote
params.label: Show the quote
params.help: Off hides the quote and its quote mark.

params.name: quote
params.label: Quote
params.help: A sentence or two in their own words. No quote marks needed.
params.default: I love the moment a frustrated customer says "oh, that was easy". This award belongs to the whole Tier 2 crew.

params.name: quote_mark
params.label: Quote mark
params.help: The big decorative mark beside the quote. Use the one your language prefers, e.g. “ « „ or 「.

params.name: show_fact
params.label: Show the fun fact
params.help: Off hides the fun-fact label and text.

params.name: fact_label
params.label: Fun-fact label
params.help: A short label, e.g. FUN FACT or ASK ME ABOUT.

params.name: fun_fact
params.label: Fun fact
params.default: Priya has run a half marathon on four continents and bakes a mean cardamom bun.

params.name: badge
params.label: Badge label
params.help: A month, a start date, a team or a milestone. Capitals read best.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: Ring, badge, small heading and decoration.

params.name: highlight
params.label: Initials circle colour
params.help: The circle behind the initials, and some of the confetti.

params.name: background
params.label: Background colour
params.help: Also the colour of the badge text.

params.name: card_color
params.label: Fun-fact card colour
params.help: A shade a little lighter than the background works best.
